name: Set upper and lower bounds
short_description: Set upper and lower bounds once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can set upper and lower bounds in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Set upper and lower bounds means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Set upper and lower bounds in a fresh real-life scenario.
